messages:
nina: quick sync — we keep hitting gaps when linking logs -> traces in dashboards. question: should the OTEL pipeline normalize and duplicate trace ids into logs before exporters (so logs, metrics, spans all have the same canonical field), or leave it to app libs?

mike: short answer: do both? apps should emit, but collector can backfill for non-structured logs. downside: cost + duplication.

sam: fwiw, the biggest pain is inconsistent key names and formats. some apps use `trace_id`, others `trace.id`, others `dd.trace_id` (datadog). Kibana dashboards expect `trace.id` in hex. We should pick one canonical name.

arjun: proposal: collector normalizes to `trace.id` (lowercase hex, 32 chars padded for 128-bit). apps can continue emitting their variant, collector maps them -> canonical. that way exporters and dashboards only need one field to join.

nina: example mapping logic? also retention question: we shard span exports to long-retention trace store (Jaeger/Tempo) but logs go to short retention (Loki/ES). linking requires the id to survive both stores.

sam: mapping logic (pseudo):
```yaml
processors:
  attributes:
    actions:
      - key: dd.trace_id
        action: convert
        from_type: string
        to_type: string
      - key: trace_id
        action: upsert
        new_key: trace.id
      - key: trace.id
        action: format
        format: lower_hex_pad128
```
collector-exporters:
  - otlp/tempo_longterm
  - loki/logs_shortterm

mike: love it. also add `trace.sampled` boolean and `trace.parent` for span->log causal hints (helps when we only have a partial span).

devex-liz: UX note — dashboards should link by `trace.id` only and fallback to `transaction.id` if present. Also add a small helper in SDKs: `Lib.add_trace_fields(log, span)` so app logs can call it without duplicating logic.

arjun: sampling math: when we sample at 0.05, logs for unsampled spans will still have trace.id (we'll keep them), so dashboard links may show partial traces. We should mark `trace.sampled=false` so trace storage doesn't expect a full trace.

nina: operational: exporters will now send the same trace.id to two backends. storage team warned about index cardinality in ES/Loki. decision: strip trace id from full-text fields and store only as a structured field to avoid huge indices.

infra-bot: collector-config v2 applied to staging: `otel-collector-2026-03-18-v2.yaml` — includes attributes mapping + trace.id normalization + add trace.sampled flag.

sam: test plan: 1) instrument a toy service with older logging lib 2) create log that only has `dd.trace_id` 3) ensure collector populates `trace.id` and exported logs + spans link in Tempo + Kibana 4) check dashboard link latency < 2s.

mike: one more: redaction/PII — never copy user identifiers into `trace.id`. trace.id should be synthetic only. collectors must not derive trace ids from PII. add policy note. :lock:

nina: OK action items: arjun to open PR for collector mapping config + tests, devex-liz to draft SDK helper, sam to write e2e checklist, mike to add retention cost estimate. we'll reconvene once PR in staging. :thumbsup:
